integrationsHub.explainer: Integrations are the services you connect to your online store so it works with the tools you already use. Shipping companies help you issue waybills and follow shipments, payment gateways let your customers pay by card or wallet into your account, and measurement tools like Meta Pixel and Google Analytics 4 show you which campaigns really bring in sales. On Tallaby you connect most of them from the Apps and integrations page in your dashboard, and payment gateways from your payment settings, with no code and no developer.
integrationsHub.closingTitle: Connect your tools to one store
integrationsHub.closingBody: Start with no monthly subscription, then turn on the integrations you need.

meta-pixel.title: Connect your store to Meta Pixel
meta-pixel.lead: Measure your Facebook and Instagram ads and see which campaigns really bring in sales, without code.
what: Meta Pixel is a Meta tool that records what visitors do in your store after clicking your ad: viewing a product, adding it to the cart or placing an order. Meta uses this data to measure your campaigns and improve who sees your ads.

On Tallaby, you paste your Pixel ID into the Apps and integrations page, and store events are sent automatically from each visitor's first page. You can also connect the Conversions API to send purchases from the server, and choose whether Purchase is sent when the order is placed or when it's delivered.

faq.q: Where do I find my Meta Pixel ID?
faq.a: In Events Manager on your Meta Business account, under Data sources.

faq.q: Do I need the Conversions API?
faq.a: It's not required, but it also sends purchases from the server, so your data stays more accurate when a browser blocks the Pixel. Sending Purchase on delivery needs it.

faq.q: When is the Purchase event sent?
faq.a: You choose in the settings: when the order is placed, or when it's delivered. Sending on delivery needs the Conversions API.

faq.q: Does the Pixel work with a product catalog?
faq.a: Yes, separately. Copy your product feed link from the Apps and integrations page and add it as a scheduled feed in Meta's Commerce Manager.

faq.q: How do I check the Pixel is working?
faq.a: Open Test Events in Events Manager, then browse your store and add a product to the cart, and the events will appear. You can also add a test code in the Conversions API settings.

faq.q: Can I connect more than one Pixel?
faq.a: No. You can connect one Pixel per store.

bosta.title: Bosta, inside your store
bosta.lead: Connect your Bosta account, send an order from your dashboard in one click, print the waybill and follow the shipment, with no addresses to copy by hand.
bosta.whatTitle: How does the Bosta integration work?
what: With the Bosta integration, an order's details go straight to your Bosta account: the customer's name, phone, address, area and the amount to collect. You copy nothing and write no waybill yourself.

You connect your account once with an API key from Bosta. Then you open an order, press "Ship with Bosta", check the area, the amount to collect and the package size, and send it. The tracking number shows on the order, you print the waybill from your dashboard, and the order's status follows Bosta's updates.
Shipping runs on your own Bosta account at your own rates. Tallaby doesn't deliver orders and adds nothing to the shipping price.

faq.q: Is the Bosta integration free?
faq.a: Connecting adds no Tallaby fee. You pay Bosta for shipping at your account's rates, and Tallaby's order fee stays what your plan charges.

faq.q: Do I need a Bosta account?
faq.a: Yes. Shipping runs on your own Bosta account; Tallaby doesn't ship for you.

faq.q: Does the order status update by itself?
faq.a: Yes. The order's status in your dashboard follows Bosta's updates, and you can open tracking on Bosta from the order.

faq.q: Can I pick the Bosta area if the address isn't recognised?
faq.a: Yes. If the address doesn't match a Bosta area, you choose the area from the list before sending.

faq.q: What about orders paid by card?
faq.a: They go with nothing to collect. An order that isn't paid yet can't go to Bosta until the payment lands.

faq.q: Does it work with more than one store?
faq.a: Yes. Each store has its own connection, so each store can use a different Bosta account.

bosta.closingTitle: Connect Bosta and ship your first order today

paymob.title: Paymob in your store, money in your account
paymob.lead: Connect your Paymob account to your store, so customers pay by card and the money goes straight to your Paymob account.
paymob.whatTitle: How does the Paymob integration work?
what: With the Paymob integration, card payments in your store run on your own gateway. The customer picks card payment, your Paymob account's payment page opens, and the amount lands in your account there.

You paste your account's keys once in Store settings › Payment methods. Tallaby checks them with a test payment that is never charged, then saves them encrypted. Once connected, card payment shows next to cash on delivery.
Paymob sets the payment fees for your account. Tallaby takes no share of sales; its fee is your plan's usual order fee.

steps.title: Customers pay by card

related.body: Cash on delivery ready from the start.

faq.q: Does Tallaby take a share of card payments?
faq.a: No. The money goes to your Paymob account, and Paymob sets the payment fees. Tallaby's fee is your plan's order fee, such as {orderFee} per order on the Free plan.

faq.q: When do I get the money?
faq.a: On your terms with Paymob: the money is paid to your account there, not to Tallaby.

faq.q: Can I connect Paymob and Kashier together?
faq.a: Each store has one card gateway. Choose Paymob or Kashier for each store.

faq.q: Does cash on delivery stay available?
faq.a: Yes. Card payment shows next to cash on delivery, and you can turn either off whenever you like.

faq.q: Are my keys safe?
faq.a: Keys are saved encrypted on the server and never show in your store, in messages or in logs.

faq.q: Do I need a developer?
faq.a: No. You paste the keys in your dashboard, and Tallaby checks them before turning card payment on.

kashier.title: Kashier in your store, money in your account
kashier.lead: Connect your Kashier account to your store, so customers pay by card on your gateway and the money goes straight to you.
kashier.whatTitle: How does Kashier work in your store?
what: The Kashier gateway in your Tallaby store is your own Kashier account. The customer picks card payment, your account's payment page opens, and the amount lands with you there.

You paste your Merchant ID, Payment API key and secret key in Store settings › Payment methods, and choose test or live mode. Tallaby checks the keys with a test payment that is never charged before saving them.
Kashier sets the payment fees for your account, and Tallaby takes no share of sales. If your account is with Paymob instead, you connect it the same way.
